steps.step: Mediation is held in the consumer mediation cell
Referral of consumer dispute for mediation by the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission
Mediator nominated by the Commission considers the rights and obligations of the parties
Mediator considers the usages of trade, if any
Mediator considers the circumstances giving rise to the consumer dispute
Mediator considers such other relevant factors as he may deem necessary
Mediator carries out mediation guided by the principles of natural justice
